I answered Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations.

The source is Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, which Marcus can see. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. In that example one trailer showed up as two rows at 06:30, because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand.

Thea's title comes from the Quarrendon contracts, which Marcus may not be able to see. A contact's title isn't a finance figure and Marcus is on the account's team, so I included it but left out any contract money terms.

That Aug 2025 message is the most recent thing I found naming a door 6 contact. Nothing newer says the contact has changed, but I haven't confirmed Thea is still the right person.
